## Reproducibility {.unnumbered}

This publication is rendered with [bookdown](https://bookdown.org){{#renv}} and its R
dependencies are pinned in `renv.lock`{{/renv}}. To rebuild it locally:

```r
bookdown::render_book("index.Rmd")
```

The rendered site is written to `_site/` and published to GitHub Pages by the
workflow in `.github/workflows/publish.yml`.
